title: Accounting and Tax Services for Foreign Shareholders of Canadian Corporations

rows.before: Section 125 gives a corporation that qualifies for the small business deduction a combined Ontario rate near 12.2% on its first $500,000 of active business income, a figure read off active business income and not off turnover.
rows.after: Section 125 gives a corporation that qualifies for the small business deduction a combined Ontario rate near 11.2% (12.2% before July 1, 2026) on its first $500,000 of active business income, a figure read off active business income and not off turnover.
rows.note: 12.2% stated as current combined Ontario small business rate; 11.2% from July 1, 2026. First R1 change on page: parenthetical added.

page_note: All 12.2% occurrences are current-rate R1. No 3.2%, 0.122/0.032, $600,000/$600K or 12.2%-derived dollar figures found.
